description: Winner Finalization and Award System (Task 17): POST finalize with guard checks + computeTournamentStandings + WinnerRecord/Award creation in transaction, GET tournament winners, pre-finalization admin page with guard checklist, and public winner detail page with cinematic Framer Motion podium. Depends on FEAT-001 (assertTournamentTransition) and FEAT-002 (computeTournamentStandings).
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/finalize/route.ts. Export POST = withPermission(AppRole.TOURNAMENT_MANAGER, async (_req, { guildId, userId, params }) => { ... }). Fetch tournament: prisma.tournament.findFirst({ where: { id: params.tournamentId, guildId }, select: { id, status, resultsLocked, game, mode, name } }) — 404 if not found. Guard checks — collect failures into array: (1) tournament.status must be 'LIVE' or 'COMPLETED'; (2) prisma.match.count({ where: { stage: { tournamentId }, status: { notIn: ['COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FORFEIT'] } } }) must be 0; (3) tournament.resultsLocked must be false. If any guard fails return 422 { error: 'finalization_guards_failed', guards: failedGuards }. Import computeTournamentStandings from @esports/scoring. Import assertTournamentTransition, InvalidTransitionError from @esports/tournament-engine. Determine targetStatus: if tournament.status === 'LIVE' use 'COMPLETED'; if already 'COMPLETED' allow re-finalization (skip transition check). In prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => { const standings = await computeTournamentStandings(tx as any, params.tournamentId, guildId); const top3 = standings.slice(0, 3); const awardTypeMap = { 1: 'CHAMPION', 2: 'RUNNER_UP', 3: 'THIRD_PLACE' }; const winnerRecords = []; for (const standing of top3): fetch team members for snapshot: const members = await tx.teamMember.findMany({ where: { teamId: standing.teamId }, include: { user: { select: { discordId, username } } } }); const rosterSnapshot = members.map(m => ({ discordId: m.user.discordId, username: m.user.username })); const wr = await tx.winnerRecord.create({ data: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, teamId: standing.teamId, placement: standing.rank, awardType: awardTypeMap[standing.rank] ?? 'CUSTOM', rosterSnapshot, version: 1 } }); winnerRecords.push(wr); // Create award for each top-3 await tx.award.create({ data: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, teamId: standing.teamId, type: awardTypeMap[standing.rank] ?? 'CUSTOM', label: awardTypeMap[standing.rank] === 'CHAMPION' ? 'Tournament Champion' : awardTypeMap[standing.rank] === 'RUNNER_UP' ? 'Runner Up' : 'Third Place', fulfillmentStatus: 'PENDING' } }); // MVP award (top fragger): const topFragger = standings.reduce((a, b) => b.totalKills > a.totalKills ? b : a, standings[0]); if topFragger: await tx.award.create({ data: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, teamId: topFragger.teamId, type: 'TOP_FRAGGER', label: 'Top Fragger', fulfillmentStatus: 'PENDING' } }); if tournament.status !== 'COMPLETED': assertTournamentTransition(tournament.status, 'COMPLETED'); await tx.tournament.update({ where: { id: params.tournamentId }, data: { status: 'COMPLETED', resultsLocked: true, completedAt: new Date() } }); await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { guildId, actorId: userId, action: 'TOURNAMENT_FINALIZED', targetType: 'Tournament', targetId: params.tournamentId } }); await tx.outboxEvent.create({ data: { guildId, type: 'TOURNAMENT_FINALIZED', payloadJson: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, name: tournament.name, winners: winnerRecords.map(w => ({ teamId: w.teamId, placement: w.placement })) }, status: 'PENDING' } }); return winnerRecords; }). Return 200 { winners: winnerRecords }.

Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/winners/route.ts. Export GET (no auth required — public). Fetch: prisma.winnerRecord.findMany({ where: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, tournament: { guildId: params.guildId }, isSuperseded: false }, include: { team: { select: { name: true, tag: true } } }, orderBy: { placement: 'asc' } }). Map to safe public shape: { id, placement, awardType, rosterSnapshot, team: { name, tag }, createdAt }. Never include internal DB IDs beyond tournamentId. Return { winners }.

Create apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/finalize/page.tsx. Server component. Auth + TOURNAMENT_MANAGER guard. Fetch tournament with match counts: prisma.tournament.findFirst({ where: { id, guildId }, select: { id, name, status, resultsLocked, game }, include: { stages: { include: { _count: { select: { matches: true } } } } } }). Count pending matches: prisma.match.count({ where: { stage: { tournamentId }, status: { notIn: ['COMPLETED','CANCELLED','FORFEIT'] } } }). Build guard list: [{ label: 'Tournament is LIVE or COMPLETED', passed: status === 'LIVE' || status === 'COMPLETED' }, { label: 'All matches completed or cancelled', passed: pendingMatchCount === 0 }, { label: 'Results not locked', passed: !resultsLocked }]. Render a GlassCard with the guard checklist (green checkmark or red X per item using lucide-react Check and X icons). Show 'Finalize Tournament' GlowButton variant='primary' — disabled if any guard fails. On click: call POST .../finalize, show sonner toast, redirect to /servers/${guildId}/admin/tournaments/${tournamentId} on success, display error details on failure.

Create apps/web/src/components/tournament/TournamentWinnersPodium.tsx. 'use client' component. Props: { winners: WinnerRecord[]; tournamentName: string } where WinnerRecord = { id, placement, awardType, rosterSnapshot: { discordId, username }[], team: { name, tag } }. Extract podiumEntries for placements 1, 2, 3. Render Framer Motion animated podium: layout is [2nd | 1st | 3rd], same as existing WinnersPodium.tsx but this one is tournament-specific (not the Hall of Fame). 1st place slot: motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, y: 40 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0, duration: 0.6, type: 'spring', bounce: 0.4 }}. 2nd place: delay: 0.3. 3rd place: delay: 0.45. 1st place card has additional glow: className includes 'shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(124,58,237,0.6)] border-violet-500/60'. Below team name, render roster: up to 4 small initials-chips (span with first 2 chars of username, className='w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-white/10 text-xs flex items-center justify-center'). Add CSS confetti using a <style> tag with @keyframes confetti-fall and absolute positioned colored divs for 1st place only (8–10 colored squares that fall and rotate — pure CSS no lib). Below podium, render an awards section: list the AwardType labels for each winner.

Create apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/winners/page.tsx. Server component with export const revalidate = 60. Fetch prisma.winnerRecord.findMany({ where: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, tournament: { guildId: params.guildId }, isSuperseded: false }, include: { team: { select: { name: true, tag: true } } }, orderBy: { placement: 'asc' } }). Fetch tournament name. If winners empty: show 'Results not yet finalized — check back after the tournament ends.' in a centered GlassCard. Serialize rosterSnapshot (it's a Json field — cast as { discordId, username }[]). Render <TournamentWinnersPodium winners={serialized} tournamentName={tournament.name} />.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter web type-check exits with code 0
POST finalize returns 422 with guards array when pending matches exist
POST finalize creates WinnerRecord rows for top-3 standings
POST finalize creates Award rows for CHAMPION, RUNNER_UP, THIRD_PLACE, and TOP_FRAGGER
POST finalize sets resultsLocked=true and status=COMPLETED on the tournament
GET /winners returns only records where isSuperseded=false, scoped to guildId
TournamentWinnersPodium.tsx uses framer-motion and compiles without errors
Public winners page shows 'not yet finalized' message when no winners exist
